result.topic_en: Formula-only calculations comparing logarithmic differences and quotients under a change of variables, seeking a linear fractional (Möbius) transformation $z \mapsto \frac{az+b}{cz+d}$ under which a function multiplies by the constant factor $\rho^2/\rho_1^2$, with a sketch of overlapping rectangles.
result.transcription:
$\log(z-p)-\log r$ | $\log \mathfrak{z}-\log\varrho$
$\log r-\log(z'-p')$ | $\log\varrho-\log\mathfrak{z}'$
$\frac{z-p}{r} \mp \frac{r}{z'-p'}$ || $\frac{\mathfrak{z}}{\varrho} \mp \frac{\varrho}{\mathfrak{z}'}$
$\frac{z-p_1}{r_1} \mp \frac{r_1}{z'-p_1}$ || $\frac{\mathfrak{z}}{\varrho_1} \mp \frac{\varrho_1}{\mathfrak{z}'}$
$\mathfrak{z} \mp \frac{\varrho^2}{\varrho_1^2}\mathfrak{z}$ $\quad z \mp \frac{az+b}{cz+d}$
$\mathfrak{z}\left(\frac{az+b}{cz+d}\right) = \frac{\varrho^2}{\varrho_1^2}\mathfrak{z}(z)$
[-...-] $\frac{\alpha z+1}{\beta z+1} \mp \frac{\alpha(az+b)+\beta(cz+d)}{\gamma(az+b)+(cz+d)}$
[-$a$-]$\frac{+c}{\gamma} = b\gamma+d$ $\quad \gamma_1 \quad \gamma_2$
$\mathfrak{z} \mp \frac{\varrho^2}{\varrho_1^2}\mathfrak{z}$
$\frac{\gamma_1 z+1}{\gamma_2 z+1} \mp \frac{(b\gamma_1+d)(\gamma_1 z+1)}{(b\gamma_2+d)(\gamma_2 z+1)}$
$\mathfrak{z} = \frac{\gamma_1 z+1}{\gamma_2 z+1}$
[sketch: two overlapping rectangles, a dot in the smaller one]

methods.what: Expressing differences of logarithms (circle/image-point construction) in the $z$ and $\mathfrak{z}$ planes as quotients
Functional equation: a linear fractional substitution multiplies the function by a constant factor
Substituting the Möbius transformation into a trial linear fractional function
Fixed-point condition for the Möbius map giving two roots $\gamma_1,\gamma_2$
Solution: the function is the linear fractional map built from the fixed-point roots, transforming by the multiplier
